units.source_text: 这春殿中繁华热闹，四时常春。

en.t: This Spring Palace was splendid and lively, and in every season it seemed always to be spring.

units.source_text: 然而以前没有可以牵引人心的美人儿，来访的贵公子等都觉得美中不足。

en.t: Yet before this there had been no beauty there who could draw people's hearts, so the noble young gentlemen who visited all felt that something was missing.

units.source_text: 但现在已经来了一个玉鬘，其人长得美玉无瑕，源氏对她的关怀也优渥无比，此种消息外间早已闻知。

en.t: But now Tamakazura had arrived; she was as flawless as a beautiful jewel, and word had already spread outside that Genji showed her extraordinary care.

units.source_text: 果然不出源氏所料，倾慕她的人不计其数。

en.t: Just as Genji had expected, countless men came to admire her.

units.source_text: 就中有几个人自知身份高贵，配做乘龙佳婿，

en.t: Among them were several who knew their own rank was high and thought themselves worthy to become her excellent husband,

units.source_text: 便巧觅良机，表示心愿，或者直率陈言，正式求婚。

en.t: so they cleverly sought good opportunities to express their wishes, or else spoke frankly and made formal proposals of marriage.

units.source_text: 然而也有几个青年公子，不便启口，独自在心中煎熬。

en.t: There were also several young gentlemen, however, who could not easily speak out and suffered alone in their hearts.

units.source_text: 其中例如内大臣的公子柏木，因为不知实情，也倾心于玉鬘。

en.t: One of these was Kashiwagi, the son of the Minister of the Center, who, not knowing the truth, also gave his heart to Tamakazura.

units.source_text: 又如兵部卿亲王，因为多年相伴的夫人死去，独居三年，孤寂不堪，

en.t: Another was the Prince Minister of War, whose wife of many years had died; after living alone for three years, he could hardly bear the loneliness,

units.source_text: 现在就不顾一切地寄予相思。

en.t: and now he cast his longing toward her without regard for anything else.

units.source_text: 今天他喝得烂醉，头上插着藤花，油腔滑调地胡闹着，样子实甚可笑。

en.t: Today he was dead drunk, with wisteria blossoms stuck in his hair, joking around in a slick, affected manner, and he looked truly ridiculous.

units.source_text: 源氏心中早已料到，脸上装作不知。

en.t: Genji had already guessed everything in his heart, but on his face he pretended to know nothing.

units.source_text: 正在飞觞劝酒之时，兵部卿亲王烦闷之极，不思再饮，拒绝了酒杯，说道：“

en.t: Just as the cups were being passed around and wine was being urged on the guests, the Prince Minister of War, in the depths of distress, had no wish to drink more, refused the cup, and said, "

units.source_text: 我但教没有心事，早已离座逃走了。

en.t: If only I had no troubles on my mind, I would have left my seat and run away long ago.
